name: Amda Iyasus
contribution: Emperor of Ethiopia for one year, from 1433 to 1434.

checks.lead: Amda Iyasus (Ge'ez: ዐምደ ኢየሱስ; died June 1434) was Emperor of Ethiopia for one year, from 1433 to 1434. His throne name Badel Nan (Ge’ez: በድል ናኝ) and a member of the Solomonic dynasty. He was the younger son of Takla Maryam.
